title: SCP-524, Walter the Omnivorous Rabbit
description: A cute little bunny… but he can eat anything!
body:
Walter the Omnivorous Rabbit adds a new entity. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-524, also known as the Walter the Omnivorous Rabbit.


SCP-524 is a rabbit capable of consuming every item and even blocks. He can be tamed using a Golden Carrot and becomes a useful companion, turning items into XP. He can also fight for you and literally eat your enemies. But do not attack SCP-524 if your not the owner of the bunny, it will also eat you! The mod also includes a few different skins that can be unlocked using nametags.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-524 spawn?

SCP-524 can spawn anywhere on the overworld surface, as long as the ground is made out of grass, dirt, mud or gravel. However, there can only one instance of SCP-524

</details>



![SCP-524](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aecb26792051eaffa239740ae9322f8e5aec848a_0.webp)

SCP-524 is an anomalous rabbit with white fur, black ears, and a black snout. He is normally passive and will not attack unless provoked. However, when attacked, he will eat his victims immediately, also players if they are dumb and decide to attack SCP-524. SCP-524 also consumes any blocks in front of him if he is hungry. SCP-524 has the unique ability to eat any item given to him. The item will be instantly consumed and permanently removed, but you will get XP and SCP-524 heals. SCP-524 can be tamed using a Golden Carrot. Once tamed, he becomes loyal to the player, and won't attack him back and defend him from other mobs. While tamed, he will only consume items when the owner is sneaking, besides dandelions, carrots or golden carrots. SCP-524 also has 5 other skin variants, that can be applied by using nametags. These 3 variants are rabbits Zcoper once had but unfortunately passed away... The nametags are "Flipsi", "Phil" or "Fluffy" and "Sparky". There are "Lopy" "Honey" "Conchita" which are saved from community members.
